item.title: AI Chip Architectures
item.description:
📝 Both training & prefill stack many tokens against the same weight matrix, so each layer's math is a large matrix-matrix multiply (GEMM), with high arithmetic intensity (compute-bound). Decode is autoregressive: the model emits one token at a time, each conditioned on every token before it, and token N+1 cannot begin until token N has been produced. Each generation adds acceleration primitives onto programmable Streaming Multiprocessors without changing the programming model.
🔗 Read more: https://www.jepeake.com/ai-chip-architectures

item.title: Rural Village in Spain Is Welcoming Digital Nomads with Open Arms
item.description:
